name: Lucia
source:
When talking about the brightest minds of Eden, one simply cannot have that conversation without Lucia. Lucia was part of the crew that went on an adventure to save Eden alongside Ravena’s parents. Naturally, she sees [url=/c166919]Ravena[/url] as a niece. Uninterested in love, she spends all of her time rebuilding robots, hoping to guarantee the existence of a friend long gone…

[In game description]
